translations.idiomatic: He rose through vice minister of ceremonies, left and right vice minister of rites, and was transferred to personnel — all concurrently academician while still serving in the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 所撰青詞皆稱旨。

translations.literal: The green prose he composed all pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The green prose he composed all pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書郭樸遷吏部，遂以訥代之。

translations.literal: When Minister of Rites Guo Pu was transferred to personnel, Ne replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister Guo Pu was transferred to personnel, Ne replaced him.

sentences.zh: 樸遭父喪，復代為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When Pu went home on mourning for his father, Ne again replaced him as minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Pu went home on mourning for his father, Ne again replaced him as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 嚴嵩當國，吏道汙雜。

translations.literal: When Yan Song held the government, personnel practice was corrupt and confused.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan Song held the government, personnel practice was corrupt and confused.

sentences.zh: 嵩敗，樸典銓猶未能盡變。

translations.literal: After Song fell Pu still presided over appointments and could not wholly reform them.
translations.idiomatic: After Song fell Pu still presided over appointments and could not wholly reform them.

sentences.zh: 訥雅意自飭，徐階亦推心任之。

translations.literal: Ne sincerely wished to discipline himself, and Xu Jie also trusted him wholeheartedly.
translations.idiomatic: Ne sincerely wished to discipline himself, and Xu Jie also trusted him wholeheartedly.

sentences.zh: 訥乃與朝士約，有事白於朝房，毋謁私邸。

translations.literal: Ne thereupon agreed with court officials that matters should be reported in the morning hall and not at private residences.
translations.idiomatic: Ne agreed with court officials that matters should be reported in the morning hall and not at private residences.

sentences.zh: 慎擇曹郎，務抑奔競，振淹滯。

translations.literal: He carefully chose bureau directors, striving to check frantic competition and revive those long neglected.
translations.idiomatic: He carefully chose bureau directors, striving to check frantic competition and revive those long neglected.

sentences.zh: 又以資格太拘，人才不能盡，仿先朝三途並用法，州縣吏政績異者破格超擢，銓政一新。

translations.literal: Because qualification rules were too rigid and talent could not be fully employed, he imitated the former practice of using three routes in parallel: officials in prefectures and counties with outstanding records in administration were promoted out of turn by exception, and personnel practice was renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Because qualification rules were too rigid, he imitated the former practice of three parallel routes: officials in prefectures and counties with outstanding records were promoted out of turn, and personnel practice was renewed.

sentences.zh: 尋錄供奉勞，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Soon, recording his service in attendance, he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, recording his service in attendance, he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，袁煒罷，命兼武英殿大學士入參機務。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year Yuan Wei was dismissed, and Ne was ordered concurrently to serve as grand secretary of the Wuying Hall and take part in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year Yuan Wei was dismissed, and Ne was ordered into the Wuying Hall as grand secretary with a seat in policy deliberations.

sentences.zh: 以代者郭樸未至，仍掌銓政。

translations.literal: Because his replacement Guo Pu had not yet arrived, he still presided over appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Because his replacement Guo Pu had not yet arrived, he still presided over appointments.

sentences.zh: 帝齋居西苑，侍臣直廬皆在苑中。

translations.literal: The emperor dwelt in seclusion in the Western Park, and attending ministers' duty lodges were all in the park.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dwelt in seclusion in the Western Park, and attending ministers' duty lodges were all in the park.

sentences.zh: 訥晨出理部事，暮宿直廬，供奉青詞，小心謹畏，至成疾久不愈。

translations.literal: Ne went out each morning to handle ministry business and lodged in the duty quarters each evening, composing green prose with careful fear until he fell ill and was long unable to recover.
translations.idiomatic: Ne went out each morning to handle ministry business and lodged in the duty quarters each evening, composing green prose with careful fear until he fell ill and could not recover.

sentences.zh: 其年冬十一月，遂乞歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of that winter he requested to return home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of that winter he asked to return home.

sentences.zh: 逾年，世宗崩，遂不復出。

translations.literal: More than a year later the Shizong Emperor died, and he never came out again.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later the Jiajing Emperor died, and he never came out again.

sentences.zh: 訥既歸裏，父母皆在。

translations.literal: After Ne returned home both his parents were still alive.
translations.idiomatic: After Ne returned home both his parents were still alive.

sentences.zh: 晨夕潔餐孝養，人以為榮。

translations.literal: Morning and evening he served them pure meals in filial care, and people regarded this as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Morning and evening he served them with pure devotion, and people regarded it as an honor.

sentences.zh: 訥嘗語人曰：「銓臣與輔臣必同心乃有濟。

translations.literal: Ne once said to others: "The personnel minister and the chief minister must be of one mind for things to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Ne once said, "The personnel minister and the chief minister must be of one mind for things to succeed.

sentences.zh: 吾掌銓二年，適華亭當國，事無阻。

translations.literal: I presided over appointments for two years, and just then Huating held the government — nothing was obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: I presided over appointments for two years while Huating held the government, and nothing was obstructed.

sentences.zh: 且所任選郎賢，舉無失人。

translations.literal: Moreover the selection directors I appointed were worthy, and in every appointment no one was misplaced.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the selection directors I appointed were worthy, and no appointment failed.

sentences.zh: 」華亭謂徐階，選郎則陸光祖也。

translations.literal: " Huating refers to Xu Jie; the selection director was Lu Guangzu.
translations.idiomatic: " Huating refers to Xu Jie; the selection director was Lu Guangzu.

sentences.zh: 家居二十年卒，年七十有四。

translations.literal: After twenty years at home he died at the age of seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty years at home he died at the age of seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 贈少保，謚文靖。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made junior guardian with the title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made junior guardian with the title Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 袁煒，字懋中，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Yuan Wei, styled Maozhong, was a native of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Wei, courtesy name Maozhong, came from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年會試第一，殿試第三，授編修。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing he came out first in the metropolitan examination and third in the palace examination, and was appointed expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 17 he placed first in the metropolitan examination and third in the palace examination, and was appointed expositor.

sentences.zh: 煒性行不羈，為御史包孝所劾，帝宥不罪。

translations.literal: Wei's conduct was unrestrained, and the censor Bao Xiao impeached him; the emperor pardoned him without punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's conduct was unrestrained; the censor Bao Xiao impeached him, but the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 進侍讀。

translations.literal: He was promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 久之，簡直西苑。

translations.literal: After a long while he was selected for duty in the Western Park.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was selected for duty in the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 撰青詞，最稱旨。

translations.literal: The green prose he composed most pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The green prose he composed most pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，閣臣推修撰全元立掌南京翰林院，帝特用煒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the grand secretaries recommended the expositor Quan Yuanli to direct the Nanjing Hanlin; the emperor specially used Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the grand secretaries recommended the expositor Quan Yuanli to direct the Nanjing Hanlin; the emperor specially chose Wei.

sentences.zh: 煒疏辭，願以故官供奉。

translations.literal: Wei memorialized to decline, wishing to serve in attendance at his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wei declined, wishing to serve in attendance at his former rank.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，立擢煒侍講學士。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and immediately promoted Wei to academician reader.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and immediately made him academician reader.

sentences.zh: 甫兩月，手詔拜禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: After only two months an imperial rescript in the emperor's own hand appointed him vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: After only two months an imperial rescript in the emperor's own hand made him vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 明年，加太子賓客兼學士，賜一品服。

translations.literal: The next year he was made guest of the heir apparent with the rank of academician and granted first-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made guest of the heir apparent with the rank of academician and granted first-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，復以供奉恩加俸二等，俄進左侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he was again given two grades added salary for service in attendance; soon he was promoted to left vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he was again given two added salary grades for service in attendance; soon he was promoted to left vice minister.

sentences.zh: 明年二月調吏部，兼官供奉如故。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year he was transferred to personnel while his attendance post remained the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the next year he was transferred to personnel while his attendance post remained the same.

sentences.zh: 逾月遷禮部尚書，加太子少保，仍命入直。

translations.literal: A month later he was made minister of rites and junior guardian of the heir apparent, and was still ordered to enter on duty.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he was made minister of rites and junior guardian of the heir apparent, and was still ordered to enter on duty.

sentences.zh: 煒自供奉以後，六年中進宮保、尚書，前未有也。

translations.literal: From the time Wei entered attendance, in six years he rose to palace guardian and minister — there had been nothing like it before.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Wei entered attendance, in six years he rose to palace guardian and minister — there had been nothing like it before.

sentences.zh: 先是二月朔，日食微陰，煒言不當救護。

translations.literal: Earlier, on the first day of the second month, there was a slight eclipse of the sun; Wei said rescue rites should not be performed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, on the first day of the second month, there was a slight eclipse; Wei said rescue rites should not be performed.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書吳山不從，得譴去。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Wu Shan did not agree and was rebuked and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of rites Wu Shan did not agree and was rebuked and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞煒言善之，遂以代山。

translations.literal: The emperor heard Wei's view and thought it good, and thereupon replaced Shan with him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard Wei's view and approved; he replaced Shan with Wei.

sentences.zh: 及七月朔，又日食。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month there was another solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month there was another solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 歷官言食止一分五杪，例免救護。

translations.literal: The Astronomical Bureau said the eclipse reached only one and five-tenths parts and that by precedent rescue was waived.
translations.idiomatic: The Astronomical Bureau said the eclipse reached only one and five-tenths parts and rescue was waived by precedent.

sentences.zh: 煒乃阿帝意上疏言：「陛下以父事天，以兄事日，群陰退伏，萬象輝華。

translations.literal: Wei thereupon flattered the emperor's intent and submitted: "Your Majesty serves Heaven as a father and the sun as an elder brother; all yin forces have retreated and the myriad phenomena shine forth.
translations.idiomatic: Wei flattered the emperor's intent and submitted, "Your Majesty serves Heaven as a father and the sun as an elder brother; all yin forces have retreated and the myriad phenomena shine forth.

sentences.zh: 是以太陽晶明，氛祲銷爍，食止一分，與不食同。

translations.literal: Therefore the sun is crystal clear, malign influences are dispelled, and the eclipse reached only one part — the same as no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sun is crystal clear, malign influences are dispelled, and the eclipse reached only one part — the same as no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 臣等不勝欣忭。

translations.literal: Your servants cannot contain our joy.
translations.idiomatic: Your servants cannot contain our joy.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，帝益喜。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered the emperor was still more pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered the emperor was still more pleased.

sentences.zh: 其冬，遂命以戶部尚書兼武英殿大學士入閣典機務。

translations.literal: That winter he was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat as minister of revenue with a seat in state affairs at the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was ordered into the Grand Secretariat as minister of revenue with a seat in state affairs at the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 累加少傅兼太子太傅、建極殿大學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly made junior preceptor, grand preceptor of the heir apparent, and grand secretary of the Jianji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly made junior preceptor, grand preceptor of the heir apparent, and grand secretary of the Jianji Hall.

sentences.zh: 四十四年春，疾篤，請假歸，道卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-fourth year he was gravely ill and requested leave to return home; he died on the road at the age of fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the forty-fourth year he was gravely ill and asked to return home; he died on the road at the age of fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈少師，謚文榮。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made junior preceptor with the title Wenrong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made junior preceptor with the title Wenrong.

sentences.zh: 煒才思敏捷。

translations.literal: Wei was quick and agile in talent and thought.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was quick and agile in talent and thought.

sentences.zh: 帝中夜出片紙，命撰青詞，舉筆立成。

translations.literal: The emperor would produce a slip of paper in the middle of the night ordering green prose composed, and Wei would finish at once with his brush.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would produce a slip of paper in the middle of the night ordering green prose, and Wei would finish at once.

sentences.zh: 遇中外獻瑞，輒極詞頌美。

translations.literal: Whenever within or without the court auspicious omens were presented he would use the most florid language in praise.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever auspicious omens were presented from within or without the court he would use the most florid language in praise.

sentences.zh: 帝畜一貓死，命儒臣撰詞以醮。

translations.literal: When a cat the emperor kept died he ordered the Confucian officials to compose a text for the offering.
translations.idiomatic: When a cat the emperor kept died he ordered the Confucian officials to compose a text for the offering.

sentences.zh: 煒詞有「化獅作龍」語，帝大喜悅。

translations.literal: Wei's text had the phrase "transforming a lion into a dragon," and the emperor was greatly delighted.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's text had the phrase "transforming a lion into a dragon," and the emperor was greatly delighted.

sentences.zh: 其詭詞媚上多類此。

translations.literal: His strange words flattering the sovereign were mostly of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His strange words flattering the sovereign were mostly of this kind.

sentences.zh: 以故帝急枋用之，恩賜稠疊，他人莫敢望。

translations.literal: For this reason the emperor urgently raised and used him; favors and gifts were heaped upon him as others did not dare to hope.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason the emperor urgently raised and used him; favors and gifts were heaped upon him as others did not dare to hope.

sentences.zh: 自嘉靖中年，帝專事焚修，詞臣率供奉青詞。

translations.literal: From the middle Jiajing reign the emperor devoted himself to Daoist cultivation and burning offerings; literary officials mostly served in composing green prose.
translations.idiomatic: From the middle Jiajing reign the emperor devoted himself to Daoist cultivation; literary officials mostly served in composing green prose.

sentences.zh: 工者立超擢，卒至入閣。

translations.literal: Those skilled at it were abruptly promoted and in the end entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Those skilled at it were abruptly promoted and in the end entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時謂李春芳、嚴訥、郭樸及煒為「青詞宰相」。

translations.literal: The age called Li Chunfang, Yan Ne, Guo Pu, and Wei the "green-prose grand secretaries."
translations.idiomatic: The age called Li Chunfang, Yan Ne, Guo Pu, and Wei the "green-prose grand secretaries."

sentences.zh: 而煒貴倨鮮淟，故出徐階門，直以氣淩之。

translations.literal: Yet Wei was arrogant, aloof, and rarely sycophantic; though he came from Xu Jie's school he directly lorded it over Jie by temperament.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Wei was arrogant and aloof; though he came from Xu Jie's school he directly lorded it over Jie by temperament.

sentences.zh: 與階同總裁《承天大志》，諸學士呈稿，煒竄改殆盡，不以讓階。

translations.literal: Together with Jie he served as chief compiler of the Great Record of Chengtian; when the academicians presented drafts Wei altered them nearly entirely and did not defer to Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Jie he served as chief compiler of the Great Record of Chengtian; when the academicians presented drafts Wei altered them nearly entirely and did not defer to Jie.

sentences.zh: 諸學士不平，階第曰任之而已。

translations.literal: The academicians were displeased; Jie only said to let him have his way.
translations.idiomatic: The academicians were displeased; Jie only said to let him have his way.

sentences.zh: 其後煒死，階亦盡竄改之。

translations.literal: After Wei died Jie also altered everything back.
translations.idiomatic: After Wei died Jie altered everything back.

sentences.zh: 煒自負能文，見他人所作，稍不當意，輒肆詆誚。

translations.literal: Wei prided himself on literary ability; when he saw others' work slightly failed to please him he would slander and ridicule at will.
translations.idiomatic: Wei prided himself on literary ability; when others' work slightly failed to please him he would slander and ridicule at will.

sentences.zh: 館閣士出其門者，斥辱尤不堪，以故人皆畏而惡之。

translations.literal: Those in the Hanlin who came from his school he insulted and humiliated beyond bearing, and for this reason people all feared and hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the Hanlin who came from his school he insulted beyond bearing, and for this reason people feared and hated him.

sentences.zh: 李春芳，字子實，揚州興化人。

translations.literal: Li Chunfang, styled Zishi, was a native of Xinghua in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfang, courtesy name Zishi, came from Xinghua in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十六年舉進士第一，除修撰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Jiajing he came out first in the metropolitan examination and was appointed expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 26 he placed first in the metropolitan examination and was appointed expositor.

sentences.zh: 簡入西苑撰青詞，大被帝眷，與侍讀嚴訥超擢翰林學士。

translations.literal: He was selected to compose green prose in the Western Park and received great imperial favor; together with the reader Yan Ne he was abruptly promoted to Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected to compose green prose in the Western Park and received great favor; with the reader Yan Ne he was abruptly made Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 尋遷太常少卿，拜禮部右侍郎，俱兼學士，直西苑如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was made vice minister of ceremonies and vice minister of rites on the right, both with the rank of academician, serving in the Western Park as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made vice minister of ceremonies and vice minister of rites on the right, both with the rank of academician, serving in the Western Park as before.

sentences.zh: 佐理部事，進左侍郎，轉吏部，代訥為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Assisting in ministry affairs he was promoted to left vice minister, transferred to personnel, and replaced Ne as minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting in ministry affairs he was promoted to left vice minister, transferred to personnel, and replaced Ne as minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 時宗室蕃衍，歲祿苦不繼。

translations.literal: At this time the imperial clans had proliferated and annual stipends could scarcely be sustained.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the imperial clans had proliferated and annual stipends could scarcely be sustained.

sentences.zh: 春芳考故事，為書上之。

translations.literal: Chunfang investigated precedents and submitted a book.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang investigated precedents and submitted a book.

sentences.zh: 諸吉兇大禮及歲時給賜，皆嚴為之制。

translations.literal: All auspicious and inauspicious rites and annual grants were strictly regulated.
translations.idiomatic: All auspicious and inauspicious rites and annual grants were strictly regulated.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，賜名《宗藩條例》。

translations.literal: The emperor praised it and granted the title Regulations for the Imperial Clans.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised it and granted the title Regulations for the Imperial Clans.

sentences.zh: 尋加太子太保。

translations.literal: Soon he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 四十四年命兼武英殿大學士，與訥並參機務。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was ordered concurrently to serve as grand secretary of the Wuying Hall and take part in state affairs together with Ne.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he was ordered into the Wuying Hall as grand secretary with a seat in state affairs together with Ne.

sentences.zh: 世宗眷侍直諸臣厚，凡遷除皆出特旨。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor favored those who attended him in duty; nearly all promotions and removals came by special edict.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiajing Emperor favored those who attended him; nearly all promotions came by special edict.

sentences.zh: 春芳自學士至柄政，凡六遷，未嘗一由廷推。

translations.literal: From academician to holding the government Chunfang was promoted six times and never once through court recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: From academician to holding the government Chunfang was promoted six times and never once through court recommendation.

sentences.zh: 春芳恭慎，不以勢淩人。

translations.literal: Chunfang was deferential and cautious and did not lord it over others by power.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang was deferential and cautious and did not lord it over others by power.

sentences.zh: 居政府持論平，不事操切，時人比之李時；

translations.literal: In government he held moderate views and did not pursue harsh measures; contemporaries compared him to Li Shi;
translations.idiomatic: In government he held moderate views and did not pursue harsh measures; contemporaries compared him to Li Shi;

sentences.zh: 其才力不及也，而廉潔過之。

translations.literal: his talent and force did not match Shi's, but he surpassed him in integrity.
translations.idiomatic: his talent did not match Shi's, but he surpassed him in integrity.

sentences.zh: 時徐階為首輔，得君甚。

translations.literal: At this time Xu Jie was chief minister and had the sovereign's heart.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Xu Jie was chief minister and had the sovereign's heart.

sentences.zh: 春芳每事必推階，階亦雅重之。

translations.literal: Chunfang yielded the lead to Jie in every matter, and Jie also esteemed him highly.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang yielded the lead to Jie in every matter, and Jie also esteemed him highly.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年春，有詔修翔鳳樓，春芳曰：「上新即位，而遽興土木，可乎？

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Longqing an edict ordered repair of the Soaring Phoenix Tower; Chunfang said: "The sovereign has just acceded — how can we at once undertake construction?
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Longqing 1 an edict ordered repair of the Soaring Phoenix Tower; Chunfang said, "The sovereign has just acceded — how can we at once undertake construction?

sentences.zh: 」事遂止。

translations.literal: The matter was thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was stopped.

sentences.zh: 齊康之劾徐階也，語侵春芳。

translations.literal: When Qi Kang impeached Xu Jie his words also touched Chunfang.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Kang impeached Xu Jie his words also touched Chunfang.

sentences.zh: 春芳疏辨求去，帝慰留之。

translations.literal: Chunfang submitted a defense requesting to leave; the emperor comforted and retained him.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang submitted a defense asking to leave; the emperor comforted and retained him.

sentences.zh: 及代階為首輔，益務以安靜，稱帝意。

translations.literal: When he replaced Jie as chief minister he governed all the more with quiet restraint, pleasing the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When he replaced Jie as chief minister he governed all the more with quiet restraint, pleasing the emperor.

sentences.zh: 時同列者陳以勤、張居正。

translations.literal: His colleagues at the time were Chen Yiqin and Zhang Juzheng.
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues were Chen Yiqin and Zhang Juzheng.

sentences.zh: 以勤端謹，而居正恃才淩物，視春芳蔑如也。

translations.literal: Yiqin was upright and cautious, while Juzheng relied on talent and looked down on others, treating Chunfang with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqin was upright and cautious, while Juzheng relied on talent and treated Chunfang with contempt.

sentences.zh: 始階以人言罷，春芳嘆曰：「徐公尚爾，我安能久？

translations.literal: When Jie left office because of public opinion Chunfang sighed: "Even Lord Xu is like this — how long can I remain?
translations.idiomatic: When Jie left office because of public opinion Chunfang sighed, "Even Lord Xu is like this — how long can I remain?

sentences.zh: 容旦夕乞身耳。

translations.literal: I can only beg to leave before long.
translations.idiomatic: I can only beg to leave before long.

sentences.zh: 」居正遽曰：「如此，庶保令名。

translations.literal: Juzheng quickly said: "In that case you may perhaps preserve a good name.
translations.idiomatic: Juzheng quickly said, "In that case you may perhaps preserve a good name.

sentences.zh: 」春芳愕然，三疏乞休，帝不允。

translations.literal: Chunfang was startled and submitted three memorials requesting retirement; the emperor would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang was startled and submitted three memorials requesting retirement; the emperor would not agree.

sentences.zh: 既而趙貞吉入代以勤，剛而負氣。

translations.literal: Before long Zhao Zhenji entered to replace Yiqin — stern and proud by nature.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhao Zhenji entered to replace Yiqin — stern and proud by nature.

sentences.zh: 及高拱再入直，淩春芳出其上，春芳不能與爭，謹自飭而已。

translations.literal: When Gao Gong again entered on duty he looked down on Chunfang and ranked above him; Chunfang could not contend and only disciplined himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Gong again entered on duty he looked down on Chunfang and ranked above him; Chunfang could not contend and only disciplined himself.

sentences.zh: 俺答款塞求封，春芳偕拱、居正即帝前決之。

translations.literal: When Altan made peace at the border and sought enfeoffment, Chunfang together with Gong and Juzheng decided the matter before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan made peace at the border and sought enfeoffment, Chunfang together with Gong and Juzheng decided the matter before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 會貞吉為拱逐，拱益張，修階故怨。

translations.literal: When Zhenji was driven out by Gong, Gong grew still more overbearing and nursed old resentment against Jie.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenji was driven out by Gong, Gong grew still more overbearing and nursed old resentment against Jie.

sentences.zh: 春芳嘗從容為階解，拱益不悅。

translations.literal: Chunfang once spoke at ease in Jie's defense; Gong was still more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang once spoke at ease in Jie's defense; Gong was still more displeased.

sentences.zh: 時春芳已累加少師兼太子太師，進吏部尚書，改中極殿，度拱輩終不容己，兩疏請歸養，不允。

translations.literal: By then Chunfang had been repeatedly made junior preceptor, grand preceptor of the heir apparent, minister of personnel, and grand secretary of the Zhongji Hall; seeing that Gong and his faction would ultimately not tolerate him, he submitted two memorials requesting to return home to care for his parents, but was not granted leave.
translations.idiomatic: By then Chunfang had been repeatedly made junior preceptor, grand preceptor, minister of personnel, and grand secretary of the Zhongji Hall; seeing that Gong and his faction would not tolerate him, he submitted two memorials asking to return home to care for his parents, but was not granted leave.

sentences.zh: 南京給事中王禎希拱意，疏詆之，春芳求去益力。

translations.literal: The Nanjing supervising secretary Wang Zhen, hoping to please Gong, memorialized vilifying him; Chunfang requested to leave all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing supervising secretary Wang Zhen, hoping to please Gong, memorialized vilifying him; Chunfang asked to leave all the harder.

sentences.zh: 賜敕乘傳，遣官護行，有司給夫廩如故事。

translations.literal: He was granted an edict to travel by relay post, officials were sent to escort him, and local offices supplied porters and grain as by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted an edict to travel by relay post, officials were sent to escort him, and local offices supplied porters and grain as by precedent.

sentences.zh: 閱一歲，拱復為居正所擠，幾不免。

translations.literal: A year later Gong was again squeezed out by Juzheng and nearly could not escape ruin.
translations.idiomatic: A year later Gong was again squeezed out by Juzheng and nearly could not escape ruin.

sentences.zh: 而春芳歸，父母尚無恙，晨夕置酒食為樂，鄉里艷之。

translations.literal: Chunfang had returned home and his parents were still well; morning and evening he set out wine and food for their pleasure, and the countryside envied him.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang had returned home and his parents were still well; morning and evening he set out wine and food for their pleasure, and the countryside envied him.

sentences.zh: 父母歿數年乃卒，年七十五，贈太師，謚文定。

translations.literal: Several years after his parents died he himself died at the age of seventy-five; he was posthumously made grand preceptor with the title Wending.
translations.idiomatic: Several years after his parents died he died at the age of seventy-five; he was posthumously made grand preceptor with the title Wending.

sentences.zh: 孫思誠，天啟六年官禮部尚書，尋罷。

translations.literal: Sun Sicheng, in the sixth year of Tianqi served as minister of rites and was soon dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sicheng, in Tianqi 6 served as minister of rites and was soon dismissed.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，坐頌榼閑住。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen he was punished for praising Rongkan and made to live in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongzhen he was punished for praising Rongkan and made to live in retirement.

sentences.zh: 思誠孫清，字映碧。

translations.literal: Sicheng's grandson Qing, styled Yingbi.
translations.idiomatic: Sicheng's grandson Qing, courtesy name Yingbi.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年進士。

translations.literal: Metropolitan graduate of the fourth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan graduate of Chongzhen 4.

sentences.zh: 由寧波推官擢刑科給事中。

translations.literal: From magistrate of Ningbo he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Punishments Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: From magistrate of Ningbo he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Punishments Bureau.

sentences.zh: 熊文燦撫張獻忠，清論其失策。

translations.literal: Xiong Wencan pacified Zhang Xianzhong; Qing argued that his strategy was mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Wencan pacified Zhang Xianzhong; Qing argued that his strategy was mistaken.

sentences.zh: 以久旱請寬刑，忤旨，貶浙江按察司照磨。

translations.literal: Because of long drought he requested leniency in punishments, offending the emperor, and was demoted to registrar in the Zhejiang surveillance commission.
translations.idiomatic: Because of long drought he requested leniency in punishments, offended the emperor, and was demoted to registrar in the Zhejiang surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 未赴，憂歸。

translations.literal: Before he took up the post he returned home on mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Before he took up the post he returned home on mourning.

sentences.zh: 起吏科給事中。

translations.literal: He was raised to supervising secretary in the Personnel Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to supervising secretary in the Personnel Bureau.

sentences.zh: 俄出封淮府，國變得不與。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent on mission to seal the Huai princedom and could not reach it because of the national upheaval.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent on mission to the Huai princedom and could not reach it because of the national upheaval.

sentences.zh: 福王時，請追謚開國名臣及武、熹兩朝忠諫諸臣，於是李善長等十四人、陸震等十四人、左光鬥等九人並得謚。

translations.literal: In the time of the Prince of Fu he requested posthumous titles for founding ministers and loyal remonstrators of the Wu and Xi reigns; thereupon Li Shanchang and fourteen others, Lu Zhen and fourteen others, and Zuo Guangdou and nine others all received posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Prince of Fu he requested posthumous titles for founding ministers and loyal remonstrators of the Wu and Xi reigns; Li Shanchang and fourteen others, Lu Zhen and fourteen others, and Zuo Guangdou and nine others all received posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 春芳曾孫信，廣東平和知縣。

translations.literal: Chunfang's great-grandson Xin was magistrate of Pinghe in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Chunfang's great-grandson Xin was magistrate of Pinghe in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 城破，與二子泓遠、淑遠同時死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he died together with his two sons Hongyuan and Shuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he died together with his two sons Hongyuan and Shuyuan.

sentences.zh: 陳以勤，字逸甫，南充人。

translations.literal: Chen Yiqin, styled Yifu, was a native of Nanchong.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yiqin, courtesy name Yifu, came from Nanchong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十年進士。

translations.literal: Metropolitan graduate of the twentieth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan graduate of Jiajing 20.

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 久之，充裕王講官，遷修撰，進洗馬。

translations.literal: After a long while he was made lecturer to the Prince of Yu, transferred to expositor, and advanced to groom.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was made lecturer to the Prince of Yu, transferred to expositor, and advanced to groom.

sentences.zh: 時東宮位號未定，群小多構釁。

translations.literal: At the time the heir apparent's title was not yet settled and petty men often provoked trouble.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the heir apparent's title was not yet settled and petty men often provoked trouble.

sentences.zh: 世宗於父子素薄，王歲時不得燕見。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor had always been cold toward father and son; the prince could not obtain an audience at the New Year feast.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiajing Emperor had always been cold toward father and son; the prince could not obtain an audience at the New Year feast.

sentences.zh: 常祿外，例有給賜，王亦不敢請。

translations.literal: Apart from regular stipends there were customary grants, but the prince also did not dare to request them.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from regular stipends there were customary grants, but the prince did not dare to request them.

sentences.zh: 積三歲，邸中窘甚。

translations.literal: For three years the princedom was in dire straits.
translations.idiomatic: For three years the princedom was in dire straits.

sentences.zh: 王左右以千金賄嚴世蕃，世蕃喜，以屬戶部，得並給三歲資。

translations.literal: Those around the prince bribed Yan Shifan with a thousand in gold; Shifan was pleased and had the Ministry of Revenue grant three years' funds at once.
translations.idiomatic: Those around the prince bribed Yan Shifan with a thousand in gold; Shifan had the Ministry of Revenue grant three years' funds at once.

sentences.zh: 然世蕃常自疑，一日屏人語以勤及高拱曰：「聞殿下近有惑誌，謂家大人何？

translations.literal: Yet Shifan often doubted himself; one day he dismissed attendants and said to Yiqin and Gao Gong: "I hear the prince lately has confused thoughts — what of my father?
translations.idiomatic: Yet Shifan often doubted himself; one day he dismissed attendants and said to Yiqin and Gao Gong, "I hear the prince lately has confused thoughts — what of my father?

sentences.zh: 」拱故為謔語，以勤正色曰：「國本默定久矣。

translations.literal: " Gong deliberately jested; Yiqin said with stern countenance: "The foundation of the state has long been silently settled.
translations.idiomatic: " Gong deliberately jested; Yiqin said sternly, "The foundation of the state has long been settled.

sentences.zh: 生而命名，從後從土，首出九域，此君意也。

translations.literal: At birth he was named with the character for heir, following the rear and the earth — foremost in the nine regions; this is the sovereign's intent.
translations.idiomatic: At birth he was named with the character for heir, following the rear and the earth — foremost in the nine regions; this is the sovereign's intent.

sentences.zh: 故事，諸王講官止用檢討，今兼用編修，獨異他邸，此相意也。

translations.literal: By precedent princely lecturers used only revisers; now editors are also used, unique among princedoms — this is the chief minister's intent.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent princely lecturers used only revisers; now editors are also used, unique among princedoms — this is the chief minister's intent.

sentences.zh: 殿下每謂首輔社稷臣，君安從受此言？

translations.literal: The prince often calls the chief minister a minister of the altars of soil and grain — how can you accept such talk?
translations.idiomatic: The prince often calls the chief minister a pillar of the state — how can you accept such talk?

sentences.zh: 」世蕃默然去。

translations.literal: Shifan left in silence.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan left in silence.

sentences.zh: 裕邸乃安。

translations.literal: The Yu princedom was thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Yu princedom was thereby settled.

sentences.zh: 為講官九年，有羽翼功，而深自晦匿，王嘗書「忠貞」二字賜之。

translations.literal: He served nine years as lecturer with merit in supporting the prince, yet deeply concealed himself; the prince once wrote the two characters "loyal and steadfast" and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: He served nine years as lecturer with merit in supporting the prince, yet deeply concealed himself; the prince once wrote "loyal and steadfast" and bestowed the words on him.

sentences.zh: 父喪除，還為侍讀學士，掌翰林院。

translations.literal: When mourning for his father ended he returned as academician reader and directed the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning for his father ended he returned as academician reader and directed the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 進太常卿，領國子監。

translations.literal: He was advanced to vice minister of ceremonies and directed the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to vice minister of ceremonies and directed the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部右侍郎，尋轉左，改吏部，掌詹事府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of rites on the right, soon transferred to the left, transferred to personnel, and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of rites on the right, soon transferred to the left, transferred to personnel, and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，以勤自以潛邸舊臣，條上謹始十事，曰定誌、保位、畏天、法祖、愛民、崇儉、攬權、用人、接下、聽言。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor acceded, Yiqin as a former servant of the hidden princedom submitted ten items on beginning with caution: fixing resolve, preserving position, fearing Heaven, following the ancestors, loving the people, cherishing frugality, gathering power, employing men, receiving subordinates, and heeding words.
translations.idiomatic: When the Longqing Emperor acceded, Yiqin as a former servant of the hidden princedom submitted ten items on beginning with caution: fixing resolve, preserving position, fearing Heaven, following the ancestors, loving the people, cherishing frugality, gathering power, employing men, receiving subordinates, and heeding words.

sentences.zh: 其言攬權、聽言尤切。

translations.literal: His words on gathering power and heeding words were especially forceful.
translations.idiomatic: His words on gathering power and heeding words were especially forceful.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其忠懇。

translations.literal: An edict praised his loyal earnestness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised his loyal earnestness.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年春，擢禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，入參機務。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Longqing he was promoted to minister of rites and grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion with a seat in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Longqing 1 he was promoted to minister of rites and grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion with a seat in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 累加少傅兼太子太傅，改武英殿。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly made junior preceptor and grand preceptor of the heir apparent and transferred to the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly made junior preceptor and grand preceptor of the heir apparent and transferred to the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 穆宗朝講希禦，政無所裁決，近幸多緣內降得厚恩。

translations.literal: In the Muzong reign audiences were rare and government was decided nowhere; favorites often obtained lavish favors through inner rescripts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longqing audiences were rare and government was decided nowhere; favorites often obtained lavish favors through inner rescripts.

sentences.zh: 以勤請勵精修政。

translations.literal: Yiqin requested diligent effort in government.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqin requested diligent effort in government.

sentences.zh: 帝心動，欲有所舉措，卒為內侍所阻，疏亦留中。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved and wished to take action, but was ultimately obstructed by inner attendants; the memorial also remained in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved and wished to take action, but was obstructed by inner attendants; the memorial also remained in the palace.

sentences.zh: 四年，條上時務因循之弊，請慎擢用：酌久任、治贓吏、廣用人、練民兵、重農谷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he submitted the abuses of routine in current affairs and requested careful promotion: weighing long tenure, punishing corrupt officials, broadening employment, drilling militia, and valuing grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he submitted the abuses of routine in current affairs and requested careful promotion: weighing long tenure, punishing corrupt officials, broadening employment, drilling militia, and valuing grain.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，下所司議。

translations.literal: The emperor praised this and referred it to the relevant offices for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised this and referred it to the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 高拱掌吏部，惡所言侵己職，寢其奏，惟都察院議行贓吏一事而已。

translations.literal: Gao Gong directed personnel and hated that the words encroached on his office; he shelved the memorial, and only the Censorate's item on punishing corrupt officials was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Gong directed personnel and hated that the words encroached on his office; he shelved the memorial, and only the Censorate's item on punishing corrupt officials was carried out.

sentences.zh: 初，以勤之入閣也，徐階為首輔，而拱方向用，朝士各有所附，交相攻。

translations.literal: When Yiqin first entered the Grand Secretariat Xu Jie was chief minister while Gong was being brought into use; court officials each had their factions and attacked one another.
translations.idiomatic: When Yiqin first entered the Grand Secretariat Xu Jie was chief minister while Gong was being brought into use; court officials each had factions and attacked one another.

sentences.zh: 以勤中立無所比，亦無私人，竟階與拱去，無訾及之者。

translations.literal: Yiqin stood in the middle with no faction and no private followers; when Jie and Gong left, no one criticized him.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqin stood in the middle with no faction and no private followers; when Jie and Gong left, no one criticized him.

sentences.zh: 及拱再入，與趙貞吉相軋，張居正復中構之。

translations.literal: When Gong entered again and clashed with Zhao Zhenji, Zhang Juzheng also sowed discord between them.
translations.idiomatic: When Gong entered again and clashed with Zhao Zhenji, Zhang Juzheng also sowed discord between them.

sentences.zh: 以勤與拱舊僚，貞吉其鄉人，而居正則所舉士也，度不能為解，恐終不為諸人所容，力引疾求罷。

translations.literal: Yiqin was an old colleague of Gong and Zhenji was his fellow townsman, while Juzheng was a man he had recommended; seeing he could not mediate and fearing he would not be tolerated, he strongly pleaded illness and asked to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqin was an old colleague of Gong and Zhenji was his fellow townsman, while Juzheng was a man he had recommended; seeing he could not mediate, he strongly pleaded illness and asked to leave.

sentences.zh: 遂進兼太子太師、吏部尚書，賜敕馳傳歸，詔其子編修於陛侍行。

translations.literal: He was thereupon promoted to grand preceptor of the heir apparent and minister of personnel, granted an edict to travel by relay post home, and his son the expositor Yubi was ordered to attend him on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand preceptor of the heir apparent and minister of personnel, granted an edict to travel by relay post home, and his son the expositor Yubi was ordered to attend him.

sentences.zh: 後二年，拱被逐，倉皇出國門，嘆曰：「南充，哲人也。

translations.literal: Two years later Gong was driven out and left the capital gate in haste, sighing: "Nanchong — a wise man.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Gong was driven out and left the capital gate in haste, sighing, "Nanchong — a wise man.

sentences.zh: 」以勤歸十年，年七十。

translations.literal: After Yiqin returned home ten years passed and he reached seventy.
translations.idiomatic: After Yiqin returned home ten years passed and he reached seventy.

sentences.zh: 復頒上方銀幣，命於陛馳歸賜之，且敕有司存問。

translations.literal: The court again bestowed imperial silver and coins, ordered Yubi to hurry home to grant them, and commanded local offices to inquire after him.
translations.idiomatic: The court again bestowed imperial silver and coins, ordered Yubi to hurry home to grant them, and commanded local offices to inquire after him.

sentences.zh: 又六年卒。

translations.literal: Six years later he died.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later he died.

sentences.zh: 贈太保，謚文端。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made grand guardian with the title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand guardian with the title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 於陛別有傳。

translations.literal: Yubi has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Yubi has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 趙貞吉，字孟靜，內江人。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhenji, styled Mengjing, was a native of Neijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhenji, courtesy name Mengjing, came from Neijiang.

sentences.zh: 六歲日誦書一卷。

translations.literal: At six he could recite one scroll of books a day.
translations.idiomatic: At six he could recite one scroll of books a day.

sentences.zh: 及長，以博洽名。

translations.literal: When grown he was famed for broad learning.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he was famed for broad learning.

sentences.zh: 最善王守仁學。

translations.literal: He was best versed in Wang Shouren's learning.
translations.idiomatic: He was best versed in Wang Yangming's learning.

sentences.zh: 舉嘉靖十四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fourteenth year of Jiajing, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in Jiajing 14, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed expositor.

sentences.zh: 時方士初進用，貞吉請求真儒贊大業。

translations.literal: At the time Daoist masters were first brought into use; Zhenji requested that true Confucians be sought to support the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Daoist masters were first brought into use; Zhenji asked that true Confucians be sought to support the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 執政不懌，因請急歸。

translations.literal: Those in power were displeased, and he thereupon requested urgent leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power were displeased, and he requested urgent leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 還朝遷中允，掌司業事。

translations.literal: On returning to court he was transferred to middle attendant and directed student affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court he was transferred to middle attendant and directed student affairs.

sentences.zh: 俺答薄都城，謾書求貢。

translations.literal: Altan pressed close to the capital and sent an insulting letter requesting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Altan pressed close to the capital and sent an insulting letter requesting tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔百官廷議，貞吉奮袖大言曰：「城下之盟，《春秋》恥之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all officials to debate at court; Zhenji rolled up his sleeves and said loudly: "A covenant under the walls — the Spring and Autumn Annals count it a disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all officials to debate at court; Zhenji rolled up his sleeves and said loudly, "A covenant under the walls — the Spring and Autumn Annals count it a disgrace.

sentences.zh: 既許貢則必入城，倘要索無已，奈何？

translations.literal: Once tribute is granted they will certainly enter the city; if their demands are endless, what then?
translations.idiomatic: Once tribute is granted they will certainly enter the city; if their demands are endless, what then?

sentences.zh: 」徐階曰：「君必有良策。

translations.literal: Xu Jie said: "You must have a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jie said, "You must have a good plan.

sentences.zh: 」貞吉曰：「為今之計，請至尊速禦正殿，下詔引咎。

translations.literal: Zhenji said: "For the present plan, let the sovereign quickly hold court in the main hall and issue an edict taking blame upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji said, "For the present, let the sovereign quickly hold court in the main hall and issue an edict taking blame upon himself.

sentences.zh: 錄周尚文功以勵邊帥，出沈束於獄以開言路；

translations.literal: Record Zhou Shangwen's merit to encourage border commanders, release Shen Shu from prison to open the way for remonstrance;
translations.idiomatic: Record Zhou Shangwen's merit to encourage border commanders, release Shen Shu from prison to open the way for remonstrance;

sentences.zh: 輕損軍之令，重賞功之格；

translations.literal: lighten orders that harm the army and weight rewards for merit;
translations.idiomatic: lighten orders that harm the army and weight rewards for merit;

sentences.zh: 遣官宣諭諸將，監督力戰，退敵易易耳。

translations.literal: send envoys to proclaim to the generals, supervise them in fighting hard — driving off the enemy is easy.
translations.idiomatic: send envoys to proclaim to the generals and supervise them in fighting hard — driving off the enemy is easy.

sentences.zh: 」時帝遣中使間廷臣，日中莫發一語。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor had sent eunuchs to sound out court officials; by midday not one word had been spoken.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had sent eunuchs to sound out court officials; by midday not one word had been spoken.

sentences.zh: 聞貞吉言，心壯之，諭嚴嵩曰：「貞吉言是，第不當及周尚文、沈束事耳。

translations.literal: Hearing Zhenji's words the emperor took heart and told Yan Song: "Zhenji is right, only he ought not to have mentioned Zhou Shangwen and Shen Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Zhenji's words the emperor took heart and told Yan Song, "Zhenji is right, only he ought not to have mentioned Zhou Shangwen and Shen Shu.

sentences.zh: 」召入左順門，令手疏便宜。

translations.literal: He was summoned to the Zuoshun Gate and ordered to write out expedients in his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the Zuoshun Gate and ordered to write out expedients in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 立擢左諭德兼監察御史，奉敕宣諭諸軍。

translations.literal: He was immediately promoted to left preceptor and concurrently investigating censor and, by imperial command, sent to proclaim to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately made left preceptor and concurrently investigating censor and, by imperial command, sent to proclaim to the armies.

sentences.zh: 給白金五萬兩，聽隨宜勞賞。

translations.literal: He was given fifty thousand taels of white silver and permitted to reward as he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: He was given fifty thousand taels of white silver and permitted to reward as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 初，貞吉廷議罷，盛氣謁嚴嵩。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhenji left the court debate he went in high spirits to visit Yan Song.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhenji left the court debate he went in high spirits to visit Yan Song.

sentences.zh: 嵩辭不見，貞吉怒叱門者。

translations.literal: Song declined and would not see him; Zhenji angrily rebuked the gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Song declined and would not see him; Zhenji angrily rebuked the gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 適趙文華至，貞吉復叱之。

translations.literal: When Zhao Wenhua arrived Zhenji rebuked him as well.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Wenhua arrived Zhenji rebuked him as well.

sentences.zh: 嵩大恨。

translations.literal: Song hated him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Song hated him deeply.

sentences.zh: 及撰敕，不令督戰，以輕其權，且不與一卒護行。

translations.literal: When drafting the imperial command he did not order supervision of battle, thereby lightening his authority, and gave him not a single soldier as escort.
translations.idiomatic: When drafting the imperial command he did not order supervision of battle, thereby lightening his authority, and gave him not a single soldier as escort.

sentences.zh: 時敵騎充斥，貞吉馳入諸將營，散金犒士，宣諭德意，明日即復命。

translations.literal: At the time enemy horsemen filled the land; Zhenji galloped into the generals' camps, scattered gold to reward the troops, proclaimed the sovereign's virtuous intent, and returned the next day to report.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy horsemen filled the land; Zhenji galloped into the generals' camps, scattered gold to reward the troops, proclaimed the sovereign's intent, and returned the next day.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，謂貞吉漫無區畫，徒為尚文、束遊說。

translations.literal: The emperor was furious, saying Zhenji had no plan at all and had merely lobbied for Shangwen and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious, saying Zhenji had no plan at all and had merely lobbied for Shangwen and Shu.

sentences.zh: 下之詔獄，杖於廷，謫荔波典史。

translations.literal: He was sent to prison by rescript, beaten at court, and demoted to registrar in Libo.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to prison by rescript, beaten at court, and demoted to registrar in Libo.

sentences.zh: 稍遷徽州通判，進南京吏部主事。

translations.literal: He was gradually transferred to assistant prefect of Huizhou and advanced to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually transferred to assistant prefect of Huizhou and advanced to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四十年，遷至戶部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he rose to vice minister of revenue on the right.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he rose to vice minister of revenue on the right.

sentences.zh: 廷議遣大臣赴薊州督餉練兵，嵩欲用貞吉，召飲示之意。

translations.literal: The court debated sending a high minister to Jizhou to supervise grain transport and drill troops; Song wished to use Zhenji and summoned him to drink and show his intent.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated sending a high minister to Jizhou to supervise grain transport and drill troops; Song wished to use Zhenji and summoned him to drink and show his intent.

sentences.zh: 貞吉曰：「督餉者，督京運乎，民運乎？

translations.literal: Zhenji said: "Does supervising grain mean supervising capital transport, or civilian transport?
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji said, "Does supervising grain mean capital transport or civilian transport?

sentences.zh: 若二運已有職掌，添官徒增擾耳。

translations.literal: If both already have responsible offices, adding officials only increases disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: If both already have responsible offices, adding officials only increases disturbance.

sentences.zh: 況兵之不練，其過宜不在是，即十戶侍出，何益練兵？

translations.literal: Moreover if troops are not drilled the fault should not lie here — even ten household stewards sent out would not help drill troops.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover if troops are not drilled the fault should not lie here — even ten household stewards would not help drill troops.

sentences.zh: 」嵩怫然罷。

translations.literal: Song left displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Song left displeased.

sentences.zh: 會嵩請告，吏部用倉場侍郎林應亮。

translations.literal: When Song requested leave the Ministry of Personnel appointed the granary vice minister Lin Yingliang.
translations.idiomatic: When Song requested leave the Ministry of Personnel appointed the granary vice minister Lin Yingliang.

sentences.zh: 比嵩出，益怒。

translations.literal: When Song came out he was still more angry.
translations.idiomatic: When Song came out he was still more angry.

sentences.zh: 令都給事中張益劾應亮，調之南京，而改用僉都御史霍冀。

translations.literal: He had the supervising secretary Zhang Yi impeach Yingliang and transfer him to Nanjing, and instead used the vice censor-in-chief Huo Ji.
translations.idiomatic: He had the supervising secretary Zhang Yi impeach Yingliang and transfer him to Nanjing, and instead used the vice censor-in-chief Huo Ji.

sentences.zh: 益又言：「督餉戶部專職，今貞吉與左侍郎劉大賓廷推不及，是不職也，宜罷。

translations.literal: Yi also said: "Supervising grain is the special duty of the Ministry of Revenue; now Zhenji and left vice minister Liu Dabin were not reached in court recommendation — this is dereliction and they ought to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yi also said, "Supervising grain is the special duty of Revenue; Zhenji and left vice minister Liu Dabin were not reached in court recommendation — they ought to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」於是二人皆奪官。

translations.literal: Thereupon both men were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon both men were stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，起禮部左侍郎，掌詹事府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he was raised to left vice minister of rites and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longqing he was raised to left vice minister of rites and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 穆宗幸太學，祭酒胡傑適論罷，以貞吉攝事。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor visited the Directorate of Education, Chancellor Hu Jie had just been dismissed for discussion; Zhenji acted in his place.
translations.idiomatic: When the Longqing Emperor visited the Directorate of Education, Chancellor Hu Jie had just been dismissed; Zhenji acted in his place.

sentences.zh: 講《大禹謨》稱旨，命充日講官。

translations.literal: He lectured on the "Counsels of Yu the Great" and pleased the emperor, who ordered him to serve among the lecturers at daily audiences.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured on the Counsels of Yu the Great and pleased the emperor, who ordered him to serve among the daily lecturers.

sentences.zh: 貞吉年逾六十，而議論侃直，進止有儀，帝深註意焉。

translations.literal: Zhenji was over sixty yet his discourse was forthright and his bearing had dignity; the emperor paid him close attention.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji was over sixty yet his discourse was forthright and his bearing dignified; the emperor paid him close attention.

sentences.zh: 尋遷南京禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to minister of rites in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to minister of rites in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 既行，帝念之，仍留直講。

translations.literal: After he set out the emperor thought of him and still retained him to lecture.
translations.idiomatic: After he set out the emperor thought of him and still retained him to lecture.

sentences.zh: 三年秋，命兼文淵閣大學士參預機務。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year he was ordered concurrently to serve as grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and take part in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year he was ordered into the Wenyuan Pavilion as grand secretary with a seat in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 貞吉入謝，奏：「朝綱邊務一切廢弛，臣欲捐軀任事，惟陛下主之。

translations.literal: When Zhenji entered to give thanks he memorialized: "Court discipline and border affairs are all in decay; your servant wishes to devote his body to service — let Your Majesty decide.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenji entered to give thanks he memorialized, "Court discipline and border affairs are all in decay; I wish to devote my body to service — let Your Majesty decide.

sentences.zh: 」帝益喜。

translations.literal: The emperor was still more pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was still more pleased.

sentences.zh: 會寇入大同，總兵官趙岢失事，總督陳其學反以捷聞，為御史燕如宦所發。

translations.literal: When bandits entered Datong the regional commander Zhao Ke lost the engagement and the grand coordinator Chen Qixue falsely reported victory, exposed by the censor Yan Ruguan.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits entered Datong the regional commander Zhao Ke lost the engagement and the grand coordinator Chen Qixue falsely reported victory, exposed by the censor Yan Ruguan.

sentences.zh: 貞吉欲置重罰，兵部尚書霍冀僅議貶秩。

translations.literal: Zhenji wished to impose heavy punishment; Minister of War Huo Ji proposed only demotion in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji wished to impose heavy punishment; the minister of war Huo Ji proposed only demotion in rank.

sentences.zh: 貞吉與同官爭不得，因上言：「邊帥失律，祖宗法具在。

translations.literal: Zhenji contended with his colleagues without success and thereupon submitted: "When border commanders violate discipline, the ancestral laws are fully in place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji contended with his colleagues without success and submitted, "When border commanders violate discipline, the ancestral laws are fully in place.

sentences.zh: 今當事者屈法徇人，如公論何？

translations.literal: Now those in charge bend the law to favor men — what of public opinion?
translations.idiomatic: Now those in charge bend the law to favor men — what of public opinion?

sentences.zh: 臣老矣，效忠無術，乞賜罷。

translations.literal: Your servant is old and has no means to serve with loyalty; I beg to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: I am old and have no means left to serve; I beg to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」不許。

translations.literal: The request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 俄加太子太保。

translations.literal: Soon he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 貞吉以先朝禁軍列三大營，營各有帥，今以一人總三營，權重難制。

translations.literal: Zhenji said that in the previous reign the forbidden army was arranged in three great camps, each with its own commander; now one man commanded all three camps — authority was too heavy and hard to control.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji said that under the previous reign the forbidden army was arranged in three great camps, each with its own commander; now one man commanded all three — authority was too heavy and hard to control.

sentences.zh: 因極言其弊，請分五營，各統以大將，稍復祖宗之舊。

translations.literal: He thereupon set forth the abuses at length and requested dividing into five camps, each commanded by a great general, somewhat restoring the ancestral pattern.
translations.idiomatic: He set forth the abuses at length and asked to divide them into five camps, each commanded by a great general, somewhat restoring the ancestral pattern.

sentences.zh: 帝善之，命兵部會廷臣議。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and ordered the Ministry of War to meet with court officials for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and ordered the Ministry of War to meet with court officials.

sentences.zh: 尚書霍冀前與貞吉議不合，頗不然其言。

translations.literal: Minister Huo Ji had earlier disagreed with Zhenji and was quite opposed to his view.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Huo Ji had earlier disagreed with Zhenji and opposed his view.

sentences.zh: 廷臣亦多謂強兵在擇將，不在變法。

translations.literal: Court officials also mostly said that strong armies lie in choosing generals, not in changing regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials also mostly said strong armies lie in choosing generals, not in changing regulations.

sentences.zh: 冀等乃上議三大營宜如故。

translations.literal: Ji and the others thereupon submitted that the three great camps ought to remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and the others submitted that the three great camps ought to remain as before.

sentences.zh: 惟以一人為總督，權太重，宜三營各設一大將，而罷總督，以文臣為總理。

translations.literal: Only because one man as overall commander had authority too heavy, each of the three camps ought to have a great general, the overall commander abolished, and a civil official made overall administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Only because one overall commander had authority too heavy, each camp ought to have a great general, the overall commander abolished, and a civil official made overall administrator.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 初，給事中楊镕劾冀貪庸。

translations.literal: Earlier the supervising secretary Yang Rong had impeached Ji as greedy and incompetent.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the supervising secretary Yang Rong had impeached Ji as greedy and incompetent.

sentences.zh: 帝已留冀，冀以镕貞吉鄉人，疑出貞吉意，疏辨乞罷，且詆貞吉。

translations.literal: The emperor had retained Ji; Ji, because Rong was Zhenji's fellow townsman, suspected this came from Zhenji and memorialized in defense asking to leave while also vilifying Zhenji.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had retained Ji; Ji, because Rong was Zhenji's fellow townsman, suspected Zhenji and memorialized asking to leave while vilifying Zhenji.

sentences.zh: 貞吉亦疏辨求去。

translations.literal: Zhenji also memorialized in defense asking to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji also memorialized in defense asking to leave.

sentences.zh: 詔留貞吉，褫冀官。

translations.literal: An edict retained Zhenji and stripped Ji of office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict retained Zhenji and stripped Ji of office.

sentences.zh: 其後營制屢更，未逾年即復其舊，貞吉亦不能爭也。

translations.literal: Afterward the camp system was changed repeatedly; within a year the old pattern was restored, and Zhenji could not contend.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the camp system was changed repeatedly; within a year the old pattern was restored, and Zhenji could not contend.

sentences.zh: 俺答款塞求封，貞吉力贊其議。

translations.literal: When Altan made peace at the border and sought enfeoffment Zhenji strongly supported the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan made peace at the border and sought enfeoffment Zhenji strongly supported the proposal.

sentences.zh: 先是，高拱再入閣即掌吏部。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Gao Gong re-entered the Grand Secretariat he immediately took charge of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Gao Gong re-entered the Grand Secretariat he immediately took charge of personnel.

sentences.zh: 貞吉言於李春芳，亦得掌都察院。

translations.literal: Zhenji spoke to Li Chunfang and also obtained charge of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji spoke to Li Chunfang and also obtained charge of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 拱以私憾欲考察科道。

translations.literal: Gong, from private resentment, wished to conduct an evaluation of the supervising secretaries and censors.
translations.idiomatic: Gong, from private resentment, wished to conduct an evaluation of the supervising secretaries and censors.

sentences.zh: 貞吉與同事上言：「頃因御史葉夢熊言事忤旨，陛下嚴諭考核言官，並及升任在籍者。

translations.literal: Zhenji and his colleagues submitted: "Recently because the censor Ye Mengxiong spoke on affairs and offended the emperor, Your Majesty sternly ordered evaluation of remonstrating officials, extending even to those promoted or on leave.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji and his colleagues submitted, "Recently because the censor Ye Mengxiong offended the emperor, Your Majesty ordered evaluation of remonstrating officials, extending even to those promoted or on leave.

sentences.zh: 應考近二百人，其中豈無懷忠報主謇諤敢言之士？

translations.literal: Nearly two hundred are to be evaluated — among them are there not men loyal to the ruler, upright, and daring to speak?
translations.idiomatic: Nearly two hundred are to be evaluated — among them are there not men loyal, upright, and daring to speak?

sentences.zh: 今一以放肆奸邪罪之，竊恐所司奉行過當，忠邪不分，致塞言路，沮士氣，非國家福也。

translations.literal: Now to charge them all with reckless wickedness — I fear the offices will carry this too far, loyal and wicked undistinguished, blocking the way of speech and dampening morale — this is not the fortune of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Now to charge them all with reckless wickedness — I fear the offices will carry this too far, loyal and wicked undistinguished, blocking speech and dampening morale — this is not the fortune of the state.

sentences.zh: 」帝不從。

translations.literal: The emperor did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not agree.

sentences.zh: 拱以貞吉得其情，憾甚。

translations.literal: Gong, because Zhenji had grasped his intent, resented him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Gong, because Zhenji had grasped his intent, resented him deeply.

sentences.zh: 及考察，拱欲去貞吉所厚者，貞吉亦持拱所厚以解。

translations.literal: At the evaluation Gong wished to remove those Zhenji favored; Zhenji also held back those Gong favored to mediate.
translations.idiomatic: At the evaluation Gong wished to remove those Zhenji favored; Zhenji also held back those Gong favored to mediate.

sentences.zh: 於是斥者二十七人，而拱所惡者鹹與。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven were dismissed, and those Gong hated were all among them.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven were dismissed, and those Gong hated were all among them.

sentences.zh: 拱猶以為憾也，嗾門生給事中韓楫劾貞吉庸橫，考察時有私。

translations.literal: Gong still felt resentment and incited his student the supervising secretary Han Ji to impeach Zhenji as mediocre and overbearing, with favoritism at the evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Gong still felt resentment and incited his student Han Ji to impeach Zhenji as mediocre and overbearing, with favoritism at the evaluation.

sentences.zh: 貞吉疏辨乞休，且言：「臣自掌院務，僅以考察一事與拱相左。

translations.literal: Zhenji memorialized in defense asking to leave, saying: "Since your servant took charge of the Censorate, in only the evaluation matter have I differed from Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji memorialized asking to leave, saying, "Since I took charge of the Censorate, in only the evaluation have I differed from Gong.

sentences.zh: 其他壞亂選法，縱肆作奸，昭然耳目者，臣噤口不能一言，有負任使，臣真庸臣也。

translations.literal: Other ruin of selection law and open wickedness plain to all — your servant has kept silent and cannot speak a word; I have failed my charge and am truly a mediocre official.
translations.idiomatic: Other ruin of selection law and open wickedness plain to all — I have kept silent; I have failed my charge and am truly mediocre.

sentences.zh: 若拱者，斯可謂橫也已。

translations.literal: As for Gong — he may be called overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: As for Gong — he may be called overbearing.

sentences.zh: 臣放歸之後，幸仍還拱內閣，毋令久專大權，廣樹眾黨。

translations.literal: After your servant returns home, I pray Gong may still return to the Grand Secretariat — do not let him long monopolize great power and widely plant factions.
translations.idiomatic: After I return home, I pray Gong may still return to the Grand Secretariat — do not let him long monopolize power and plant factions.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，竟允貞吉去，而拱握吏部權如故。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered Zhenji's departure was granted, while Gong held personnel power as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered Zhenji's departure was granted, while Gong held personnel power as before.

sentences.zh: 貞吉學博才高。

translations.literal: Zhenji's learning was broad and his talent high.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji's learning was broad and his talent high.

sentences.zh: 然好剛使氣，動與物迕。

translations.literal: Yet he loved to be forceful and show his temper, always clashing with others.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he loved to be forceful and show his temper, always clashing with others.

sentences.zh: 九列大臣，或名呼之，人亦以是多怨。

translations.literal: Among the nine chief ministers he sometimes called them by name; people therefore mostly resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Among the nine chief ministers he sometimes called them by name; people therefore resented him.

sentences.zh: 高拱、張居正名輩出貞吉後，而進用居先。

translations.literal: Gao Gong and Zhang Juzheng were junior to Zhenji in standing yet were promoted before him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Gong and Zhang Juzheng were junior to Zhenji in standing yet were promoted before him.

sentences.zh: 鹹負才好勝不相下，竟齟齬而去。

translations.literal: All were talented and competitive and would not yield; in the end they clashed and left.
translations.idiomatic: All were talented and competitive and would not yield; in the end they clashed and left.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十年卒，贈少保，謚文肅。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Wanli he died; he was posthumously made junior guardian with the title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 10 he died; he was posthumously made junior guardian with the title Wensu.

sentences.zh: 殷士儋，字正甫，歷城人。

translations.literal: Yin Shidan, styled Zhengfu, was a native of Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shidan, courtesy name Zhengfu, came from Licheng.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十六年進士。

translations.literal: Metropolitan graduate of the twenty-sixth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan graduate of Jiajing 26.

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 久之，充裕王講官。

translations.literal: After a long while he was made lecturer to the Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was made lecturer to the Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 凡關君德治道，輒危言激論，王為動色。

translations.literal: Whenever it touched the prince's virtue or the way of governing he would speak stern warnings and sharp discourse; the prince was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever it touched the prince's virtue or governance he spoke stern warnings; the prince was moved.

sentences.zh: 遷右贊善，進洗馬，直論如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right assistant companion and advanced to groom, lecturing as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right assistant companion and advanced to groom, lecturing as before.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年擢侍讀學士，掌翰林院事，進禮部右侍郎，未幾改吏部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing he was promoted to academician reader and directed Hanlin affairs, advanced to vice minister of rites on the right, and soon transferred to personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 1 he was promoted to academician reader and directed Hanlin affairs, advanced to vice minister of rites on the right, and soon transferred to personnel.

sentences.zh: 明年春，拜禮部尚書，掌詹事府事。

translations.literal: The next spring he was appointed minister of rites and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring he was appointed minister of rites and directed the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 其冬，還理部事。

translations.literal: That winter he returned to directing ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he returned to directing ministry affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年正月朔望，日月俱食。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month in the fourth year both sun and moon were eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day in the fourth year both sun and moon were eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 士儋疏請布德、緩刑、納諫、節用，飭內外臣工講求民瘼。

translations.literal: Shidan memorialized requesting spreading virtue, leniency in punishments, acceptance of remonstrance, and frugality, and ordering inner and outer officials to seek the people's distress.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan memorialized requesting spreading virtue, leniency in punishments, acceptance of remonstrance, and frugality, and ordering officials to seek the people's distress.

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: The response acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: The court noted receipt.

sentences.zh: 以舊恩，進太子太保。

translations.literal: Because of old favor he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Because of old favor he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 時寒暑皆罷講，士儋請如故事，四時無輟，並進講《祖訓》及《大學衍義》、《貞觀政要》。

translations.literal: At the time lectures were suspended in both cold and heat; Shidan requested following precedent without pause through the four seasons, and also lecturing on the Ancestral Injunctions, the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, and the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign.
translations.idiomatic: Lectures were suspended in both cold and heat; Shidan asked to follow precedent without pause through the four seasons, and also to lecture on the Ancestral Injunctions, the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, and the Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted this.

sentences.zh: 始世宗定宗藩條例，親王無後，以兄弟及兄弟之子嗣，不得以旁繼。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor first fixed regulations for the imperial clans, if a prince had no heir a brother or brother's son might succeed, but collateral succession was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiajing Emperor first fixed regulations for the imperial clans, if a prince had no heir a brother or brother's son might succeed, but collateral succession was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖末，肅懷王薨，無子。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiajing the Prince of Su Huai died without a son.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Jiajing the Prince of Su Huai died without a son.

sentences.zh: 其大母定王妃請以輔國將軍縉貴嗣，禮部議縉貴實懷王從叔，不可承祧。

translations.literal: His grandmother the Princess of Ding requested that the assistant-state general Jin Gui succeed; the Ministry of Rites argued Jin Gui was in fact the prince's uncle and could not inherit the ancestral line.
translations.idiomatic: His grandmother the Princess of Ding requested that the assistant-state general Jin Gui succeed; the Ministry of Rites argued Jin Gui was the prince's uncle and could not inherit the ancestral line.

sentences.zh: 詔許以將軍攝府事。

translations.literal: An edict permitted the general to administer the princedom.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted the general to administer the princedom.

sentences.zh: 及帝即位，王妃復請，前尚書高儀執不可。

translations.literal: When the emperor acceded the princess again requested; the former minister Gao Yi held firm that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor acceded the princess again requested; the former minister Gao Yi held firm that it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 縉貴重賄中官，屬宗人為奏，祈必得。
