translations.literal: Jin Gui heavily bribed inner attendants and had clansmen memorialize, praying he must obtain succession.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Gui heavily bribed inner attendants and had clansmen memorialize, insisting he must obtain succession.

sentences.zh: 士儋持之甚力。

translations.literal: Shidan held out very firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan held out very firmly.

sentences.zh: 帝以肅藩越在遠塞，不王無以鎮之，遂許縉貴嗣。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the Su princedom was far on the frontier and without a prince could not be secured, thereupon permitted Jin Gui to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because the Su princedom was on the frontier and without a prince could not be secured, permitted Jin Gui to succeed.

sentences.zh: 士儋爭曰：「肅府自甘州徙蘭州，實內地。

translations.literal: Shidan contended: "The Su princedom was moved from Ganzhou to Lanzhou — it is in fact inner territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan contended, "The Su princedom was moved from Ganzhou to Lanzhou — it is in fact inner territory.

sentences.zh: 且請別選郡王賢者理府事，毋遂私請，壞條例。

translations.literal: Moreover I ask that another worthy commandery prince be chosen to administer the princedom — do not follow this private request and ruin the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover choose another worthy commandery prince to administer the princedom — do not follow this private request and ruin the regulations.

sentences.zh: 」而帝意堅不可奪。

translations.literal: The emperor's intent was firm and could not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's intent was firm and could not be changed.

sentences.zh: 士儋乃請封為郡王，諸宗率以此令從事，帝終不許。

translations.literal: Shidan thereupon requested enfeoffment as commandery prince; the clans all took this order as precedent, yet the emperor ultimately would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan asked for enfeoffment as commandery prince; the clans took this as precedent, yet the emperor would not agree.

sentences.zh: 故事，郊畢，舉慶成宴。

translations.literal: By precedent after the suburban sacrifice a celebration banquet was held.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent after the suburban sacrifice a celebration banquet was held.

sentences.zh: 自世宗倦勤，典禮久廢。

translations.literal: From the time the Shizong Emperor wearied of government the ritual had long lapsed.
translations.idiomatic: From the time the Jiajing Emperor wearied of government the ritual had long lapsed.

sentences.zh: 帝即位三載，猶未舉行，士儋始考定舊儀行之。

translations.literal: Three years after the emperor acceded it had still not been held; Shidan first investigated and fixed the old ritual and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: Three years after the emperor acceded it had still not been held; Shidan investigated the old ritual and carried it out.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命以本官兼文淵閣大學士入閣辦事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat as minister with a seat in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was ordered into the Grand Secretariat as minister with a seat in affairs.

sentences.zh: 俄俺答封事成，進少保，改武英殿。

translations.literal: Soon Altan's enfeoffment was completed and he was made junior guardian and transferred to the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Altan's enfeoffment was completed and he was made junior guardian and transferred to the Wuying Hall.

sentences.zh: 始士儋與陳以勤、高拱、張居正並為裕邸僚，三人皆柄用，士儋仍尚書，不能無望。

translations.literal: At first Shidan together with Chen Yiqin, Gao Gong, and Zhang Juzheng had all been colleagues in the Yu princedom; the three men all held power while Shidan remained minister — he could not be without hope.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shidan with Chen Yiqin, Gao Gong, and Zhang Juzheng had all been colleagues in the Yu princedom; the three held power while Shidan remained minister — he could not be without hope.

sentences.zh: 拱素善張四維，欲引共政，而惡士儋不親己，不為援。

translations.literal: Gong had always been friendly with Zhang Siwei and wished to bring him into government, yet hated that Shidan was not close to him and did not support him.
translations.idiomatic: Gong had always been friendly with Zhang Siwei and wished to bring him into government, yet hated that Shidan was not close to him and did not support him.

sentences.zh: 士儋遂藉太監陳洪力，取中旨入閣，以故怨拱及四維。

translations.literal: Shidan thereupon relied on the eunuch Chen Hong's power and obtained an inner rescript to enter the Grand Secretariat; for this reason he resented Gong and Siwei.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan relied on the eunuch Chen Hong and obtained an inner rescript to enter the Grand Secretariat; for this he resented Gong and Siwei.

sentences.zh: 四維父擅鹽利，為御史郜永春所劾。

translations.literal: Siwei's father monopolized salt profits and was impeached by the censor Hao Yongchun.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei's father monopolized salt profits and was impeached by the censor Hao Yongchun.

sentences.zh: 事已解，他御史復及之。

translations.literal: The matter was already resolved when other censors raised it again.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was resolved when other censors raised it again.

sentences.zh: 拱、四維疑出士儋指，益相構。

translations.literal: Gong and Siwei suspected this came at Shidan's direction and sowed discord all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Gong and Siwei suspected Shidan and sowed discord all the more.

sentences.zh: 御史趙應龍遂劾士儋進由陳洪，不可以參大政。

translations.literal: The censor Zhao Yinglong thereupon impeached Shidan for entering through Chen Hong and being unfit to participate in great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Zhao Yinglong impeached Shidan for entering through Chen Hong and being unfit for great affairs.

sentences.zh: 士儋再辨求去，不允。

translations.literal: Shidan again defended himself and asked to leave; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan again defended himself and asked to leave; this was denied.

sentences.zh: 而拱門生都給事中韓楫復揚言脅之，士儋亦疑出拱指。

translations.literal: Gong's student the chief supervising secretary Han Ji again spread threats, and Shidan also suspected this came from Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Gong's student Han Ji again spread threats, and Shidan suspected Gong.

sentences.zh: 故事，給事中朔望當入閣會揖。

translations.literal: By precedent supervising secretaries on the first and fifteenth of the month ought to enter the Grand Secretariat for the assembly bow.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent supervising secretaries on the first and fifteenth ought to enter the Grand Secretariat for the assembly bow.

sentences.zh: 士儋面詰楫曰：「聞君有憾於我，憾自可耳，毋為他人使。

translations.literal: Shidan confronted Ji face to face: "I hear you bear resentment toward me — resentment is your own affair, but do not be another's tool.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan confronted Ji: "I hear you resent me — that is your affair, but do not be another's tool.

sentences.zh: 」拱曰：「非體也。

translations.literal: Gong said: "This is not proper.
translations.idiomatic: Gong said, "This is not proper.

sentences.zh: 」士儋勃然起，詬拱曰：「若逐陳公，逐趙公，復逐李公，今又為四維逐我，若能常有此座耶？

translations.literal: Shidan rose in anger and reviled Gong: "You drove out Lord Chen, drove out Lord Zhao, drove out Lord Li — now you drive me out for Siwei; can you keep this seat forever?
translations.idiomatic: Shidan rose in anger and reviled Gong, "You drove out Lord Chen, Lord Zhao, Lord Li — now you drive me out for Siwei; can you keep this seat forever?

sentences.zh: 」奮臂欲毆之。

translations.literal: He swung his arm as if to strike him.
translations.idiomatic: He swung his arm as if to strike him.

sentences.zh: 居正從旁解，亦誶而對。

translations.literal: Juzheng mediated from the side and also reviled in reply.
translations.idiomatic: Juzheng mediated from the side and also reviled in reply.

sentences.zh: 御史侯居良復劾士儋始進不正，求退不勇。

translations.literal: The censor Hou Juliang again impeached Shidan for improper entry at first and lack of courage in seeking to leave.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Hou Juliang impeached Shidan for improper entry and lack of courage in seeking to leave.

sentences.zh: 士儋再疏請益力，乃賜道里費，乘傳歸，有司給稟隸如故事。

translations.literal: Shidan submitted another memorial asking all the harder; he was granted travel expenses, traveled by relay post home, and local offices supplied grain and attendants as by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Shidan submitted another memorial; he was granted travel expenses, traveled by relay post home, and local offices supplied grain and attendants as by precedent.

sentences.zh: 家居十一年卒。

translations.literal: After eleven years at home he died.
translations.idiomatic: After eleven years at home he died.

sentences.zh: 時居正垂沒，四維為政，怨士儋。

translations.literal: At the time Juzheng was near death and Siwei held the government; he resented Shidan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Juzheng was near death and Siwei held the government; he resented Shidan.

sentences.zh: 贈太保，謚文通。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made grand guardian with the title Wentong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand guardian with the title Wentong.

sentences.zh: 久之，改謚文莊。

translations.literal: After a long while the title was changed to Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while the title was changed to Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 高儀，字子象，錢塘人。

translations.literal: Gao Yi, styled Zixiang, was a native of Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yi, courtesy name Zixiang, came from Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十年進士。

translations.literal: Metropolitan graduate of the twentieth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan graduate of Jiajing 20.

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed expositor.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as Hanlin bachelor, appointed expositor.

sentences.zh: 歷侍講學士，掌南京翰林院。

translations.literal: He rose through academician reader and directed the Nanjing Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through academician reader and directed the Nanjing Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 召為太常卿，掌國子監事。

translations.literal: He was summoned as vice minister of ceremonies and directed affairs of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as vice minister of ceremonies and directed the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部右侍郎，改吏部，教習庶吉士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of rites on the right, transferred to personnel, and instructed Hanlin bachelors.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of rites on the right, transferred to personnel, and instructed Hanlin bachelors.

sentences.zh: 四十五年代高拱為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he replaced Gao Gong as minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he replaced Gao Gong as minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，諸大典禮皆儀所酌定。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor acceded, all the great ritual codes were set by Yi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Longqing Emperor acceded, all the great ritual codes were set by Yi.

sentences.zh: 世宗遺命，郊社及祔享祔葬諸禮，悉稽祖制更定。

translations.literal: By the Shizong Emperor's testament, suburban sacrifices and the rites of enshrinement, joint sacrifice, and burial were all investigated against ancestral regulations and revised.
translations.idiomatic: By the Jiajing Emperor's testament, suburban sacrifices and the rites of enshrinement, joint sacrifice, and burial were investigated against ancestral regulations and revised.

sentences.zh: 儀乃會廷臣議：天地分祀不必改；

translations.literal: Yi thereupon met with court officials to discuss: separate sacrifice to Heaven and Earth need not be changed;
translations.idiomatic: Yi met with court officials: separate sacrifice to Heaven and Earth need not be changed;

sentences.zh: 既祭先農，不當復祈谷西苑；

translations.literal: since the First Farmer is already sacrificed to, there should be no further prayer for grain in the Western Park;
translations.idiomatic: since the First Farmer is already sacrificed to, there should be no further prayer for grain in the Western Park;

sentences.zh: 帝社、帝稷、睿宗明堂配天與玉芝宮專祀，當廢；

translations.literal: the Imperial Altar of Soil and Grain, the Ruizong Hall's matching Heaven in the Bright Hall, and exclusive sacrifice at the Yuzhi Palace ought to be abolished;
translations.idiomatic: the Imperial Altar of Soil and Grain, the Ruizong Hall's matching Heaven in the Bright Hall, and exclusive sacrifice at the Yuzhi Palace ought to be abolished;

sentences.zh: 孝潔皇后當祔廟，別祀孝烈於他所。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaojie ought to be enshrined in the temple, with Xiaolie separately sacrificed elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaojie ought to be enshrined in the temple, with Xiaolie separately sacrificed elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 帝皆報可。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all.

sentences.zh: 既而中官李芳復請天地合祀如洪武制，御史張槚請易皇極諸殿名，盡復其舊，儀皆持不可。

translations.literal: Soon the eunuch Li Fang again requested combined sacrifice to Heaven and Earth as in the Hongwu system; the censor Zhang Ji requested changing the names of the Huangji and other halls and fully restoring the old names — Yi held firm against both.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the eunuch Li Fang again requested combined sacrifice as in the Hongwu system; the censor Zhang Ji requested restoring old hall names — Yi held firm against both.

sentences.zh: 帝踐阼四月，未召對大臣，儀屢請。

translations.literal: Four months after the emperor acceded he had not summoned the great ministers for audience; Yi repeatedly requested it.
translations.idiomatic: Four months after the emperor acceded he had not summoned the great ministers; Yi repeatedly requested it.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年正月饗太廟，帝將遣代，儀偕僚屬諫，閣臣亦以為言，乃親祀如禮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Longqing, at the feast in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the emperor was about to send a substitute; Yi together with subordinates remonstrated, and the grand secretaries also spoke — the emperor thereupon performed the sacrifice in person as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Longqing 2, at the feast in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the emperor was about to send a substitute; Yi remonstrated, the grand secretaries spoke — the emperor performed the sacrifice in person.

sentences.zh: 慶府輔國將軍縉貴請襲王爵，儀執不從。

translations.literal: The assistant-state general Jin Gui of the Qing princedom requested to inherit the princely title; Yi held firm and did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant-state general Jin Gui of the Qing princedom requested to inherit the princely title; Yi held firm and did not agree.

sentences.zh: 太子生七齡，儀疏請出閣，帝命待十齡行之。

translations.literal: When the crown prince reached seven sui Yi memorialized requesting he leave the palace; the emperor ordered this done at ten sui.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince reached seven Yi memorialized requesting he leave the palace; the emperor ordered this at ten.

sentences.zh: 詔取光祿銀二十萬兩，儀力爭。

translations.literal: An edict took two hundred thousand taels of silver from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yi strove against it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict took two hundred thousand taels of silver from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yi strove against it.

sentences.zh: 初，世宗崇道教，太常多濫員，儀奏汰四十八人。

translations.literal: Earlier the Shizong Emperor revered Daoism and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had many supernumerary posts; Yi memorialized to cut forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Jiajing Emperor revered Daoism and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had many supernumerary posts; Yi memorialized to cut forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 寺卿陳慶奏供事乏缺，儀堅持不可。

translations.literal: Director Chen Qing memorialized that service posts lacked personnel; Yi held firm and would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Director Chen Qing said service posts lacked personnel; Yi held firm and would not agree.

sentences.zh: 掌禮部四年，每歲暮類奏四方災異，遇事秉禮循法，居職甚稱。

translations.literal: Directing the Ministry of Rites for four years, each year's end he submitted a classified memorial on calamities in every quarter; in affairs he upheld ritual and followed law — his tenure was highly praised.
translations.idiomatic: Directing the Ministry of Rites for four years, each year's end he submitted calamities from every quarter; he upheld ritual and law — his tenure was highly praised.

sentences.zh: 引疾章六上，卒見留。

translations.literal: He submitted six memorials citing illness requesting leave, yet was always retained.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted six memorials citing illness, yet was always retained.

sentences.zh: 會御史傅寵以先帝時撰文叩壇事劾儀，儀四疏求去，乃加太子少保馳傳歸。

translations.literal: When the censor Fu Chong impeached Yi for composing texts and knocking at the altar in the previous reign's time, Yi submitted four memorials asking to leave and was thereupon made junior guardian of the heir apparent and sent home by relay post.
translations.idiomatic: When the censor Fu Chong impeached Yi for altar rites in the previous reign, Yi submitted four memorials asking to leave and was made junior guardian and sent home by relay post.

sentences.zh: 歸二年，用高拱薦，命以故官侍東宮講讀，掌詹事府。

translations.literal: Two years after returning home, on Gao Gong's recommendation he was ordered to his former rank to lecture the heir apparent and direct the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Two years after returning, on Gao Gong's recommendation he was ordered to his former rank to lecture the heir apparent and direct the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年四月詔兼文淵閣大學士入閣辦事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year an edict ordered him concurrently to enter the Grand Secretariat as minister with a seat in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year an edict ordered him into the Grand Secretariat as minister with a seat in affairs.

sentences.zh: 逾月，帝崩，預顧命。

translations.literal: A month later the emperor died; he was named in the testamentary command.
translations.idiomatic: A month later the emperor died; he was named in the testamentary command.

sentences.zh: 及拱為張居正所逐，儀已病，太息而已。

translations.literal: When Gong was driven out by Zhang Juzheng, Yi was already ill and could only sigh.
translations.idiomatic: When Gong was driven out by Zhang Juzheng, Yi was already ill and could only sigh.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，謚文端。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made grand guardian of the heir apparent with the title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand guardian with the title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 儀性簡靜，寡嗜欲，室無妾媵。

translations.literal: Yi's nature was simple and quiet, with few desires; he had no concubines in his household.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was simple and quiet, with few desires; he had no concubines.

sentences.zh: 舊廬毀於火，終身假館於人。

translations.literal: His old house was destroyed by fire and he lodged in others' houses all his life.
translations.idiomatic: His old house was destroyed by fire and he lodged in others' houses all his life.

sentences.zh: 及沒，幾無以殮。

translations.literal: When he died he almost had nothing for burial.
translations.idiomatic: When he died he almost had nothing for burial.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：費宏等皆起家文學，致位宰相。

translations.literal: The appraiser says: Fei Hong and the others all rose from literary studies to the rank of chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: The appraiser says: Fei Hong and the others all rose from literary studies to the rank of chief minister.

sentences.zh: 宏卻錢寧，拒宸濠，忤張、桂，再躓再起，終亦無損清譽。

translations.literal: Hong refused Qian Ning, rejected Chenhao, opposed Zhang and Gui, fell twice and rose again, and in the end his clear reputation was undiminished.
translations.idiomatic: Hong refused Qian Ning, rejected Chenhao, opposed Zhang and Gui, fell and rose again, and his clear reputation was undiminished.

sentences.zh: 李時、翟鑾皆負才望，而鑾晚節不振。

translations.literal: Li Shi and Zhai Luan both had talent and standing, yet Luan's late years did not hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi and Zhai Luan both had talent and standing, yet Luan's late years did not hold firm.

sentences.zh: 貞吉負氣自高，然處傾軋之勢，即委蛇，庸得免乎？

translations.literal: Zhenji was proud and self-exalting, yet in a situation of crushing pressure — even with compliance, how could he escape?
translations.idiomatic: Zhenji was proud and self-exalting, yet in crushing pressure — even with compliance, how could he escape?

sentences.zh: 顧鼎臣等雍容廟堂，可謂極遭逢之盛。

translations.literal: Gu Dingchen and the others were at ease in the hall of state — one may say they met with the fullest favor of the times.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Dingchen and the others were at ease in the hall of state — they met with the fullest favor of the times.

sentences.zh: 而陳以勤誠心輔導，獻納良多。

translations.literal: Yet Chen Yiqin sincerely guided and remonstrated with much offered.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Chen Yiqin sincerely guided and remonstrated with much offered.

sentences.zh: 後賢濟美，繼登相位。

translations.literal: Later worthy men carried on the excellence and in turn reached the chief ministership.
translations.idiomatic: Later worthy men carried on the excellence and reached the chief ministership.

sentences.zh: 終明之世，稱韋、平者，數以勤父子。

translations.literal: Through the Ming dynasty, those called Wei and Ping were numbered among the Yiqin father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Ming dynasty, those called Wei and Ping were numbered among the Yiqin father and son.

sentences.zh: 天之報之，何其厚哉。

translations.literal: How thick Heaven's reward to them!
translations.idiomatic: How thick Heaven's reward to them!
